column1: # THE VOLATILITY EXIT (2026-10-03, the consumer's request 1): the simple exit the consumer trades,
# written down completely, read on the record the way `vol_exit_of` / `volExitOf` reads a path.
# The rule: the sample sd (n - 1) of the last 24 daily simple returns of the PRINTED close, first
# read once a full window exists; below 1.5% the rule holds the index, at or above 2.0% it holds
# cash, between it keeps its position, and it starts holding. Decided at the close of session t,
# filled at the close of t + 1, earning from t + 1 to t + 2. Cash earns the effective federal funds
# rate over 252 (FRED DFF at the start of each session). The 3x leg is reset daily: 3 times the
# index's simple TOTAL return, less 2 x (the rate + 0.60%) x the calendar days the session spans
# over 360, less a 0.86% expense ratio over 252.
# vol-exit timing pts/yr           the rule at 1x less buy-and-hold, points a year of log growth,
#                                  over the sessions from the first one a decision earns
# vol-exit 3x interaction pts/yr   the rule on the 3x leg less the 3x leg held, less the timing row
# Banded like `recordbands-2026-09-26.tsv`'s rows: the record's one-year-block resamples, each
# session's close return, total return, rate and calendar days kept together, read at
# `RECORD_BAND_PCTS`, and a joint band over the two rows that a record-like world clears on both
# at once 95% of the time (their own family: the other banded rows' bands are unchanged).
# nasdaq  QQQ, 1999-03-11..2026-08-20 (Yahoo Finance): the printed close (split-adjusted) for the
#         rule's signal and the adjusted close for its total return; the set's equity window.
# sp500   CRSP value-weighted US market total return from Ken French's
#         F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (202606), Mkt-RF + RF compounded, as both the signal and
#         the return (it has no printed close), 1954-07-02..2026-06-30, the window DFF covers.
# The -closes file is a `date,close,adj_close` CSV, one row a session; the -fred file is FRED's
# `date,value` DFF CSV.
# Generated by `rust/src/bin/record_bands.rs -volexit` (twin: `jsrc/recordBands.sc -volexit`):
#   record_bands -volexit -closes <data>/QQQ-closes.csv -fred <data>/DFF.csv
#       -from 1999-03-10 -to 2026-08-20 -set nasdaq -series QQQ -joint 0.05 -of 2 -header
#   record_bands -volexit -french <data>/french/F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily.csv -fred <data>/DFF.csv
#       -from 1954-07-01 -to 2026-06-30 -set sp500 -series CRSP -joint 0.05 -of 2
